title: Acrospire
summary: AC'ROSPIRE, noun [Gr. highest, a spire, or spiral line.] A shoot, or sprout of a seed; the plume, or plumule, so called from its spiral form.

inlines.v: AC'ROSPIRE, noun [Gr. highest, a spire, or spiral line.] A shoot, or sprout of a seed; the plume, or plumule, so called from its spiral form.
